title: Moroccan Veggie Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry dish inspired by Moroccan cuisine, packed with velvety texture from the vegetables and a hint of Middle Eastern spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the cumin, coriander, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the mushrooms, carrots, and zucchini. Cook for 4-5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the peas and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the peas are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
